2. Scrutiny and interview by District Task Force Committee
3. EDP training for 7 days conducted by EDI
4. Bank disburses loan with subsidy credited to subsidy reserve fund

Scheme Name (English): Chief Minister's Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam
Scheme Name (Tamil): முதலமைச்சரின் உழவர் பாதுகாப்புத் திட்டம்
Sub-Category: Social Security & Comprehensive Insurance for Farmers
Description (English): Comprehensive social security scheme covering small/marginal farmers and agricultural laborers in Tamil Nadu. Provides accident death relief (Rs. 1 Lakh), natural death assistance, educational aid for children, marriage aid, and old-age pension.
Description (Tamil): விவசாயிகள் மற்றும் விவசாயத் தொழிலாளர்களுக்கு விபத்து மரண நிவாரணம் (ரூ.1,00,000), இயற்கை மரண நிவாரணம் (ரூ.20,000), கல்வி உதவித்தொகை, திருமண உதவி மற்றும் முதியோர் ஓய்வூதியம் வழங்கும் ஒருங்கிணைந்த பாதுகாப்பு திட்டம்.
Official Benefits:
Accident Death Relief: ₹1,00,000 to nominee
Natural Death Relief: ₹20,000
Marriage Assistance: ₹8,000 - ₹10,000
Education Assistance: ₹1,250 to ₹6,000 per year for children studying in college/polytechnic
Eligibility Criteria:
Age: 18 to 65 years
Key Conditions:
  • Small/marginal farmers owning up to 2.5 acres of wet land or 5.0 acres of dry land, or landless agricultural laborers
  • Must be registered members holding Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam identity card
Required Documents:
• Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam Membership Identity Card
• Patta / Chitta or Certificate of Agricultural Laborer from VAO
• Aadhaar Card
• Smart Ration Card
• Bank Account details
Application Steps:
1. Enroll as member through Village Administrative Officer / Taluk Office
2. Receive Uzhavar Card
3. Claim benefits upon occurrence of event (marriage, education, death/accident) at Taluk Office
4. Direct benefit credit to registered bank account

Scheme Name (English): Handloom Weavers Old Age Pension Scheme
Scheme Name (Tamil): கைத்தறி நெசவாளர் மாதாந்திர முதியோர் ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம் (ரூ.1,000)
Department: Handlooms, Handicrafts, Textiles and Khadi Department
Description (English): Lifetime monthly social security pension of Rs. 1,000 paid to senior handloom weavers aged 60 years and above who have dedicated their lives to the traditional handloom weaving profession.
Description (Tamil): 60 வயது பூர்த்தியடைந்த கைத்தறி நெசவாளர்களுக்கு வாழ்நாள் முழுவதும் மாதந்தோறும் ரூ.1,000 ஓய்வூதியம் மற்றும் இலவச வேட்டி/சேலை வழங்கும் திட்டம்.
Official Benefits: Monthly Pension: ₹1,000 per month credited directly to bank account for life
Eligibility Criteria:
Age: 60 to 100 years
Key Conditions:
  • Must have worked as a handloom weaver for at least 15 years
  • Must be a member of a registered Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society in Tamil Nadu
Required Documents:
• Weavers Co-operative Society Service Certificate
• Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID showing 60+ years)
• Smart Family Ration Card
• Bank Passbook
Application Steps:
1. Submit application through Handloom Weavers Society to Assistant Director of Handlooms
2. Verification and sanction order issued by Handlooms Directorate
Contact Helpline: Assistant Director of Handlooms & Textiles in respective district

Scheme Name (English): Destitute Widow Pension Scheme
Scheme Name (Tamil): ஆதரவற்ற விதவை ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம்
Description (English): Provides a monthly pension of Rs. 1,200 along with free rice and dhotis/sarees twice a year to destitute widows residing in Tamil Nadu.
Description (Tamil): கணவனை இழந்த ஆதரவற்ற பெண்களுக்கு மாதாந்திர நிதி ஆதரவாக ரூ.1,200 மற்றும் இலவச வேட்டி/சேலை மற்றும் இலவச அரிசி வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
Official Benefits:
Pension Amount: ₹1,200 per month
Ancillary Benefits: Free rice and seasonal clothing (sarees)
Mode: Direct Benefit Transfer
Eligibility Criteria:
Age: 18 to 100 years
Gender: Female
Annual Income Limit: Under Rs. 100,000
Key Conditions:
  • Must be a destitute widow
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Must not have remarried
  • Family income should not exceed Rs. 1,00,000 per annum
Required Documents:
• Death Certificate of Husband
• Destitute Widow Certificate (issued by Revenue Tahsildar)
• Smart Ration Card
• Aadhaar Card
• Bank Passbook
Application Steps:
1. Obtain Destitute Widow Certificate through e-Sevai
2. Apply for Destitute Widow Pension at e-Sevai centre
3. VAO and Revenue Inspector enquiry
4. Approval by Special Tahsildar (Social Security Schemes)
5. Pension credited monthly
